about_page.vision_text: To become the recognized and reputable reference for industrial chemical supply in the region, by expanding our product portfolio, value-added technical services, and international quality standards.

about_page.value3_desc: Our engineering team understands your production process and offers a fitting technical solution, not just a product.
about_page.value4_desc: Time means money in industry. We commit to delivery times and take them seriously.

services_trading.hero_title: Industrial Chemicals Trading, Import & Customs Clearance
services_trading.hero_subtitle: From supplier negotiations to delivery at your warehouse, leave the entire import chain to us.
services_trading.overview_title: Chemical Imports, Made Simple and Transparent
services_trading.intro_p1: Khavar Sadra's trading and import team serves domestic industries through a broad network of trusted suppliers in China, India, the UAE, Turkey and Europe. With expertise in import regulations, letters of credit and international negotiations, our team secures competitive pricing and reliable delivery terms, making overseas purchasing predictable and dependable.
services_trading.intro_p2: Customs clearance is one of the most sensitive stages of importing. Without the right expertise, shipments can face lengthy delays, rising storage costs or even seizure. Khavar Sadra's customs specialists use their experience in tariff classification, declaration preparation and coordination with customs and standards authorities to clear shipments as quickly and cost-effectively as regulations allow.
services_trading.intro_p3: We manage every stage, from order intake to delivery at your warehouse, so you do not have to navigate the complexities of importing alone. Cargo insurance, selection of the best sea, land or air route, and temporary storage are all part of our service. We keep you clearly informed about your shipment at every stage.
services_trading.steps_title: From Order to Delivery in Five Steps
services_trading.steps_subtitle: Scroll down to move through the timeline.
services_trading.step1_desc: We record your requirements, including grade, purity and packaging, then formalize them in a contract covering the confirmed price, delivery schedule and payment terms for full transparency.
services_trading.step2_title: Sourcing from Domestic and International Suppliers
services_trading.step2_desc: We select the required grade from trusted domestic or international suppliers based on quality, price and lead time. Samples can be provided for approval before bulk purchasing when needed.
services_trading.step3_desc: We select the most suitable route and mode of transport, including containerized sea freight, land transport or a combination, and insure the shipment from origin to destination to minimize the risk of damage, theft or loss.
services_trading.step4_desc: We prepare the customs declaration, determine the tariff classification and obtain required permits, including standards, health and quarantine approvals. Our specialists coordinate each step with customs and the relevant authorities.
services_trading.step5_desc: After clearance, our logistics partners deliver the goods to your warehouse. A delivery receipt and certificate of analysis are provided in both physical and digital formats for complete shipment traceability.
services_trading.routes_title: Khavar Sadra's Supply Network at a Glance
services_trading.routes_subtitle: We source and deliver your goods from five major global chemical supply hubs.
services_trading.routes_note: This map is illustrative only and does not show the countries' exact geographic locations.
services_trading.benefits_title: Why Entrust Your Imports to Khavar Sadra?
services_trading.benefits_subtitle: Our specialists turn import complexity into an opportunity to save you time and money.
services_trading.benefit1_desc: With years of international market experience and expertise in letters of credit, our commercial specialists select reliable suppliers based on quality, price and performance.
services_trading.benefit2_desc: Our knowledge of customs regulations, tariffs, exemptions and standards and health procedures helps ensure fast, compliant and cost-effective clearance while minimizing the risk of shipment delays.
services_trading.benefit3_desc: We coordinate containerized sea, bulk land, air and rail freight with cargo insurance, tailored to your shipment, delivery urgency and budget.
services_trading.benefit4_desc: Every shipment is insured from origin to destination to cover the risk of damage, theft, fire or loss in transit.
services_trading.faq_title: Common Questions About Trading and Clearance
services_trading.faq_subtitle: Clear answers to questions clients often ask before entrusting us with their imports.
services_trading.faq1_q: How long do importing and customs clearance take?
services_trading.faq1_a: Timing depends on the origin and type of goods. Imports from China and India usually take 45–60 days, from the UAE and Turkey 20–30 days, and from Europe 35–50 days. Customs clearance typically takes 5–10 business days after arrival, and may take up to 15 days when standards or health permits are required.
services_trading.faq2_q: What types of goods do you clear?
services_trading.faq2_a: We handle industrial chemicals, detergent raw materials, polymers, resins, additives and surfactants. Our services also include standards, health and quarantine permits for regulated goods. When special permits are required, such as for pharmaceutical or food products, we coordinate with the relevant authorities.
services_trading.faq3_q: Do you hold valid import/export licenses and a tax ID?
services_trading.faq3_a: Yes. Khavar Sadra holds valid import/export licenses, a tax ID, membership in the Chamber of Commerce and an electronic signature certificate for online declarations. Transactions are completed through the banking system with full legal documentation.
services_trading.faq4_q: How are your service fees calculated?
services_trading.faq4_a: Trading and clearance fees are generally calculated as a percentage of the shipment's CIF value or set under a separate agreement. After reviewing the goods, volume, origin and required services such as insurance, domestic transport and permits, we provide a clear, itemized pro forma invoice before the contract is signed.

services_trading.cta_desc: Send our commercial team the product type, grade and quantity you need. We will quickly provide a pro forma invoice with the landed cost delivered to your warehouse.

services_supply.title: Industrial Chemicals Supply & Distribution
services_supply.subtitle: Reliable supply chain with central warehouse in Tehran, domestic and international supplier network, nationwide distribution fleet and diverse packaging; from price quotation to delivery at your factory gate.
services_supply.intro_title: A transparent, fast and reliable supply chain
services_supply.intro_text: Supplying industrial chemicals is not just buying and selling; it is a complex chain from source to factory gate that can face risks of delay, quality drop or cost increase at every stage. Khavar Sadra manages this chain for you with over a decade of experience. From selecting trusted suppliers and inbound inspection, to storage in the central warehouse, issuing certificate of analysis, and finally nationwide delivery to your factory gate, all stages are controlled by our expert team. Below, we introduce the four main pillars of our supply chain — warehouse, sourcing network, distribution fleet and packaging — so you can decide with open eyes.
services_supply.warehouse_desc: Khavar Sadra's central warehouse is located in the heart of Tehran and, with an area of over three thousand square meters, provides the capacity to simultaneously store several thousand tons of chemicals in various grades and packaging. The warehouse is divided into precise zones based on hazard class, material type and storage conditions (dry, cool, separated from oxidizers) to ensure safety and authenticity throughout. The barcode system and warehouse management software allow us to see the inventory of each product code in real time and plan orders based on priority and delivery time. The warehouse team, consisting of experienced warehousemen and trained workers, carries out loading and unloading in full compliance with safety principles. All inbound shipments are inspected for consistency with the analysis sheet and visual condition before being placed on shelves, so no non-compliant goods enter the supply chain.
services_supply.sourcing_desc: Khavar Sadra's supplier network is the result of over a decade of continuous relationships with reputable domestic manufacturers and international factories in China, India, Turkey, Korea and Europe. We evaluate each supplier before adding them to our portfolio for quality certifications (ISO, GMP, REACH), ability to supply consistently with stable grade, and on-time delivery record. This evaluation is repeated periodically to keep quality on track. For imported materials, our commercial team manages the entire process of purchasing, insurance, sea or air freight and customs clearance, and using our customs experience, minimizes the time for shipments to reach the warehouse. The diversity of suppliers allows us to quickly activate alternative sources during market fluctuations or supply problems from one source, ensuring continuity of your production.
services_supply.fleet_desc: To deliver orders on time and safely, Khavar Sadra works with a network of partner transport fleets across the country. This fleet includes flatbed and platform trucks in 3 to 24 ton capacities, light pickups for small orders, and flatbed trailers for bulk shipments. For corrosive, toxic or flammable materials, vehicles licensed for hazardous materials transport (ADR) are used to ensure route safety. All partner drivers are trained in safe loading and unloading of chemicals and coordinate with the warehouse team during critical times. Our shipping coverage includes all 31 provinces; orders within Tehran are usually delivered the same day or the next, and intercity orders reach their destination within 24 to 72 hours after preparation, depending on route and distance. Shipment tracking and real-time customer notification are available throughout the journey.
services_supply.packaging_title: Diverse Packaging Tailored to Your Needs
services_supply.packaging_desc: At Khavar Sadra, we know that proper packaging not only ensures transport safety but also affects the efficiency of your production process. That's why we offer diverse packaging options based on material type, consumption volume and customer storage conditions. For powder and solid materials, 25 kg multi-layer bags with moisture-proof coating, 50 and 200 kg plastic or metal drums, and for bulk orders, one-ton Big Bags are available. Liquid materials are offered in 5 to 30 liter jerrycans, 200 liter drums and one-ton IBCs. For industrial customers with high consumption, bulk and tanker delivery in high tonnage is also available. All packaging comes with Persian labels including product name, CAS number, purity, production date, expiry and safety marks, and custom customer labeling can be applied on request.
services_supply.graph_title: A Look at Khavar Sadra's Supply Chain
services_supply.graph_subtitle: From supply source to your factory gate, every stage is controlled by our team.
services_supply.benefits_title: Benefits of Working with Khavar Sadra
services_supply.benefits_subtitle: Four main reasons to entrust your chemical supply chain to us.
services_supply.benefit1_desc: We are committed to delivery time. With a central warehouse, partner fleet and shipment tracking, we guarantee delivery at the agreed time and transparently report any delays.
services_supply.benefit2_desc: Our central warehouse in Tehran with over 3000 square meters and a digital warehouse management system enables fast preparation and stable inventory for you.
services_supply.benefit3_desc: Shipping coverage to all 31 provinces. For Tehran orders, same-day delivery and for other cities, 24 to 72-hour delivery after loading.
services_supply.benefit4_desc: With warehouse management software, we see the inventory of each product in real time and report the exact status to you at quotation time so you can plan with confidence.
services_supply.steps_subtitle: Five transparent steps from first contact to factory-gate delivery and beyond.
services_supply.step1_desc: You announce your need via call, WhatsApp or website form. Our technical expert suggests the appropriate grade, purity, packaging and quantity based on your application.
services_supply.step2_desc: Price, purity, packaging, delivery time and payment terms are clarified in an official proforma. After your confirmation, the order is registered in the system and the warehouse is notified.
services_supply.step3_desc: The product is selected from the warehouse, inspected in the quality control lab, and a Certificate of Analysis (COA) is issued. No shipment leaves the warehouse without a COA.
services_supply.step4_desc: Final packaging, labeling and loading onto the fleet appropriate for the material type is done. The tracking number and driver information are announced to you.
services_supply.step5_desc: The shipment arrives at the destination at the agreed time. After delivery, our technical support team is available for any questions about use, storage or safety.
services_supply.faq_subtitle: Answers to common customer questions about ordering, delivery and distribution coverage.
services_supply.q1_q: What is the minimum order quantity?
services_supply.q1_a: The minimum order varies by product and packaging. For most powder and solid materials, the minimum is one 25 kg bag or one drum, and for liquids, a minimum of one jerrycan or drum. For bulk orders (over one ton), special pricing applies. If your required amount is below the minimum, we try to offer a solution; for example, free lab samples may be available in some cases. To find out the minimum order for each product and get a proforma, just contact our sales expert.
services_supply.q2_q: What is the order delivery time?
services_supply.q2_a: Delivery time depends on warehouse inventory, order quantity and destination. For products in stock at Khavar Sadra and orders within Tehran, delivery is usually done the same business day or the next day at the latest. For other cities, depending on distance, 24 to 72 hours after final confirmation and loading is needed. If the product is not in stock and needs to be sourced from a supplier, the delivery time is accurately stated in the proforma as 3 to 10 business days. In urgent cases, with priority coordination, same-day dispatch is possible.
services_supply.q3_q: How wide is the geographic coverage?
services_supply.q3_a: Khavar Sadra's distribution coverage includes all 31 provinces. In major cities such as Karaj, Isfahan, Shiraz, Mashhad, Tabriz, Ahvaz, Qom, Rasht and Kermanshah, daily or alternate-day shipping is done, and for more distant cities, 2 to 4 business days are needed based on the shipping route. For customers with dedicated shipping service or intermediate warehouses, delivery to that point and then internal distribution by you is also possible. In special areas (such as ports or remote industrial zones), with prior coordination, exact cost and time are announced.
services_supply.q4_q: What can you do for emergencies?
services_supply.q4_a: Khavar Sadra has a special service for emergency situations and production line stoppages. Just contact our sales expert and describe the situation; our team checks warehouse inventory at the first opportunity and, if the product is in stock, coordinates urgent dispatch. For orders within Tehran, same-hour or few-hour dispatch is possible in many cases. In other cities, using urgent freight or air shipping, the shipment reaches you in the shortest time. This service is performed with higher priority for customers with annual contracts.
services_supply.cta_desc: Contact Khavar Sadra sales experts now or send your inquiry via WhatsApp. Inventory, price and delivery time will be announced to you in the shortest time.
